Red hotel rents are $1050 each.

The correct action is end_turn. I will keep the public message brief and consistent with prior turns.

Rolls 4 through 11 from Pennsylvania Avenue are safe. Only rolls 3 and 5 guarantee instant bankruptcy. Player 1's red hotels are also fatal later, but not this turn. If I survive, I will land past the dark blue hotels or on the luxury tax.
